summary: This is a Form 6-K filed by DDC Enterprise Ltd, a foreign private issuer, reporting a routine change of its principal executive office address to 301 S McDowell Street Suite 125, Charlotte, NC 28204, effective July 2, 2026. The filing contains no mention of any acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private transaction, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC activity, or forced management change. It is a purely administrative current report under Rule 13a-16 with no special-situations content.
